summary: Twilio's transactional and marketing email delivery service.
access_note: Free plans retired in 2025; new accounts get a 60-day trial, then a paid plan is needed to keep sending.
blocker_note: Users need a paid plan (or active trial) to send email.

evidence.quote: The Twilio SendGrid Web API v3 supports API keys
After that, an upgrade to a paid plan will be required to continue sending email and accessing key tools
Sign up for a free trial
The SendGrid v3 Web API provides a REST interface to send email at scale
Allows AI Agents to interact with the Twilio SendGrid v3 API, managing contact lists, templates, single sends, and stats

notes: No official SendGrid MCP found (Twilio docs and twilio-labs/mcp show none). Free plan retired in 2025 (changelog); pricing page offers a free trial. The 60-day figure comes from the changelog transition period, not the trial length.

review.reason: A tutorial for building a server is not an existing MCP server; the repo is an actual community server.
